title: Scene Health × Data Health — Showcase
description: Builds a small synthetic factory SceneModel + DataModel programmatically, with deliberate defects spanning both inspectors. SceneHealth opens on the right and surfaces duplicate wall geometries, a degenerate triangle, unused vertices, identity / orphan transforms, unused materials and textures, an NPOT texture, and a textured-material-on-no-UVs binding. DataHealth opens on the left and surfaces duplicate property-set refs, a schema-tag mismatch, an unknown type, an orphaned IfcSpace, walls aggregated under a storey instead of contained, plus a self-reference and an IfcRelAggregates cycle. Every flaw is annotated inline in the example's index.js so users can chase a panel highlight back to a single line.
